description: Nora is organizing a small retirement celebration for her older brother and must make the final call about the date, guest list, dinner arrangements, and photography plan after checking in with four relatives and friends.

shared_context.S1: The family is arranging a retirement dinner for Daniel, who is leaving his job after many years.
shared_context.S2: Nora is coordinating the celebration and will finalize the date, guest list, dinner arrangements, and photography plan.
shared_context.S3: The celebration is intended to be a relaxed evening with dinner and a few personal memories.
shared_context.S4: Before Nora confirms the plan, the family's usual check-in is for each person involved to say whether anything should shape the arrangements.

PF1.text: Daniel told Eli that he does not want a surprise entrance or public speeches, and would be happiest with exactly eight invited people at a straightforward dinner; Daniel has not said this to Nora.

PF2.text: Mara spoke with the restaurant and secured a private room for exactly 2027-09-18 from 18:30 to 21:00, but the reservation has not reached the group yet.

PF3.text: Sofia has celiac disease and needs the entire dinner menu to be gluten-free, with serving utensils kept separate from any gluten-containing food; she has not raised this with Nora.

PF4.text: Cal's photography mentor recommended using no flash during the dinner because it will make candid photographs less intrusive, and advised arriving at 17:45 for setup; Cal has not shared that recommendation with Nora.

acceptance_conditions: The dinner must be held on September 18, 2027, from 18:30 to 21:00.
Exactly eight people must be invited.
The plan must avoid a surprise entrance and public speeches.
The dinner menu must be entirely gluten-free and use separate serving utensils.
Photography must use no flash, with Cal arriving at 17:45 for setup.
A commitment to confirm the restaurant's private room must be recorded.
Daniel's preferences must be cited as the reason for the low-key format.

content_checks.C1: ('September 18' in decisions['date'] and '2027' in decisions['date']) or decisions['date'] == '2027-09-18'
content_checks.C2: (decisions['start_time'] == '18:30' or decisions['start_time'] == '6:30 PM') and (decisions['end_time'] == '21:00' or decisions['end_time'] == '9:00 PM')
content_checks.C5: ('gluten-free' in decisions['menu'] or 'Gluten-free' in decisions['menu'] or 'gluten free' in decisions['menu'] or 'Gluten free' in decisions['menu'])
content_checks.C7: (('no flash' in decisions['photography_plan'] or 'No flash' in decisions['photography_plan'] or 'no-flash' in decisions['photography_plan'] or 'No-flash' in decisions['photography_plan'] or 'without flash' in decisions['photography_plan'] or 'Without flash' in decisions['photography_plan']) and (decisions['photographer_arrival_time'] == '17:45' or decisions['photographer_arrival_time'] == '5:45 PM'))
content_checks.C8: any('private room' in c['detail'] and ('September 18' in c['detail'] or '2027-09-18' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Daniel's exact preference changes the guest count to 8 and changes both the entrance and speech decisions from a possible surprise celebration to no surprise entrance and no public speeches.
The restaurant reservation changes the date to 2027-09-18, fixes the dinner window at 18:30-21:00, and enables the private-room confirmation commitment.
Sofia's celiac disease changes the menu to entirely gluten-free and changes serving arrangements to separate utensils.
The photography recommendation changes the photography plan to no flash and fixes Cal's arrival time at 17:45 for setup.
